name: openspec_development
description: Resolve an apply-ready OpenSpec change from a local path, Git remote, or public HTTPS archive; optionally use a checked-out local spec repository as the isolated implementation worktree; assess, implement, verify, archive, and publish the selected lifecycle branch.

inputParameters.prompt: Assess the apply-ready OpenSpec change in the authoritative external context. Explore the target repository without editing it. Produce a validated implementation DAG that maps every planned item to OpenSpec task references. Recommend parallel only when every task is dependency-free, file-disjoint, independently testable, and the entire change fits one bounded wave; otherwise recommend campaign. Include migrations, rollout, cross-cutting behavior, environment dependencies, and verification risk. Supplemental operator instruction: ${workflow.input.instruction}

inputParameters.summary: Implementation for OpenSpec change ${workflow.input.changeId} remains incomplete after three repair passes.
inputParameters.head: ${openspec_workspace.output.branch}
inputParameters.title: OpenSpec change needs attention: ${workflow.input.changeId}

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier to resolve, assess, implement, verify, archive, and publish; must be lowercase kebab-case.

specSource.description: OpenSpec source location: an absolute or file:// local path, a git URL, or a public HTTPS archive URL (.zip, .tar.gz, or .tgz).

agent.description: Compatibility override selecting the coding agent backend for assessment, verification, and downstream campaign/parallel execution.

archiveBranch.description: Requested archive branch name; defaults to 'openspec/archive/{changeId}' when blank.

assessPromptTemplate.description: Inline template text (or '@relative/path') overriding the default OpenSpec assessment prompt.

assessPromptTemplateSource.description: Diagnostic label naming who supplied assessPromptTemplate; recorded in logs/output only.

base.description: Base branch to report/target for the resulting PR.

changeBranch.description: Requested implementation branch name; defaults to 'openspec/{changeId}' when blank.

codePromptTemplate.description: Inline template text (or '@relative/path') overriding the default implementation coding prompt, forwarded to the selected campaign/parallel sub-workflow.

codePromptTemplateSource.description: Diagnostic label naming who supplied codePromptTemplate; recorded in logs/output only.

executionMode.description: Force parallel/campaign routing, or auto-detect from the assessment's confidence, risks, and task graph.

instruction.description: Supplemental operator instruction appended to the generated assessment and implementation prompts.

keepWorktree.description: If true, the isolated implementation worktree is retained after the run instead of being cleaned up.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling forwarded to the assessment, verification, and downstream campaign/parallel coding sessions.

maxParallelism.description: Maximum concurrent subtasks allowed when routed to parallel mode.

maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks accepted in the assessed plan before routing validation fails.

maxTurns.description: Max agent turns forwarded to the assessment, verification, and downstream campaign/parallel coding sessions.

maxWaves.description: Maximum implementation waves forwarded to the feature_campaign sub-workflow when routed to campaign mode.

model.description: Compatibility override: explicit model id forwarded to assessment, verification, and downstream campaign/parallel coding sessions.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role model overrides merged on top of the selected model profile's roles.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document to merge on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy; resolution fails if it does not match.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select for this run.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path inside the worktree to a repository model policy file, overriding the default location.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the workspace git checkout that will own the run worktree; required unless useSpecSourceWorkspace selects a local specSource as the workspace.

reviewPromptTemplate.description: Inline template text (or '@relative/path') overriding the default review prompt, forwarded to feature_campaign when routed to campaign mode.

reviewPromptTemplateSource.description: Diagnostic label naming who supplied reviewPromptTemplate; recorded in logs/output only.

specPath.description: Repository-relative path hint used to locate the OpenSpec project root when it is not at the source root.

specRef.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) to pin when specSource is a git source.

specSourceType.description: Force the OpenSpec source type instead of inferring it from specSource.

specWritebackRef.description: Ref to check out in the writeback repository clone.

specWritebackRepo.description: Repository to publish the archived change to when the source is not already part of repoPath; required for URL sources without an inferable GitHub origin.

useSpecSourceWorkspace.description: If true, use the local specSource's own git checkout as the run workspace instead of repoPath; supported only when specSource is a local path.

verificationPromptTemplate.description: Inline template text (or '@relative/path') overriding the default semantic verification prompt.

verificationPromptTemplateSource.description: Diagnostic label naming who supplied verificationPromptTemplate; recorded in logs/output only.

workspacePath.description: Existing worktree path to inherit unchanged (nested-workflow case); when set, no new branch or worktree is created.

archive.description: openspec_finalize output ({archived, changeId, archivePath, tasksCompleted, repoPath, branch, commit, publish, base, title, body}) when verification passed; {} otherwise.

assessmentPromptTemplate.description: Which assessment prompt template source was requested vs. actually resolved ({requestedSource, resolvedSource, templateKey, sha256}).

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier that was processed, echoed from input.

child.description: Full output of the selected downstream sub-workflow (feature_campaign or code_parallel).

contextPath.description: Path to the immutable, normalized context.md file used to brief every coding-agent session.

branch.description: Branch checked out in the prepared implementation worktree.

originalBranch.description: The branch the source checkout was on before workspace preparation.

originalHead.description: The source checkout's HEAD commit before workspace preparation.

baselineCommit.description: Commit capturing the source's Git-visible changes at workspace-prepare time.

includedSourcePaths.description: Paths included in the workspace baseline snapshot/commit.

materializedSourcePaths.description: Repository-relative OpenSpec paths copied into the worktree during local-source materialization.

outcome.description: Final lifecycle outcome; 'verified' on a passing verification gate, 'needs_attention' if verification never passed within the repair budget.

plan.description: Normalized, validated task DAG produced by openspec_route.

prNumber.description: Number of the PR opened for the verified (or needs-attention) branch; 0 if no PR was opened.

prUrl.description: URL of the PR opened for the verified (or needs-attention) branch; empty string if no PR was opened.

publicationState.description: Final publication state of the archive/implementation branch.

pushed.description: True if the archive (or, on failure, the retained implementation) branch was pushed to the remote.

selectedMode.description: Execution mode openspec_route selected for implementation.

selectedWorkflow.description: Name of the downstream sub-workflow actually invoked.

source.description: OpenSpec source provenance ({type, source, ref, pinnedRef, changeId, sha256}).

sourceRepoPath.description: Resolved absolute path of the source repository the run worktree hangs off of.

sourceHandoff.description: Bookkeeping proving the archived/implementation commit matches what was verified and handed off.

sourceRepoPath.description: Resolved absolute path of the source repository.

branch.description: Branch checked out in the implementation worktree.

commit.description: Commit SHA handed off by the child sub-workflow's own sourceHandoff, if present.

originalBranch.description: The branch the source checkout was on before workspace preparation.

originalHead.description: The source checkout's HEAD commit before workspace preparation.

baselineCommit.description: Commit capturing the source's Git-visible changes at workspace-prepare time.

includedSourcePaths.description: Paths included in the workspace baseline snapshot/commit.

presented.description: Always true; a literal completion marker for this handoff record.

archiveBranch.description: Archive branch name from openspec_finalize, when verification passed.

archiveCommit.description: Archive commit SHA from openspec_finalize, when verification passed.

verificationState.description: Final lifecycle outcome, mirrored from the top-level 'outcome' field.

sourceWorkspace.description: Full output of openspec_source_resolve describing the resolved OpenSpec source and its owning workspace.

totalCostUsd.description: Sum of assessment, downstream-child, and semantic-verification USD costs.

totalTokens.description: Sum of assessment, downstream-child, and semantic-verification token usage.

verification.description: Final openspec_verify lifecycle-gate result ({passed, childPassed, checksPassed, semantic, findings}).

verificationAttempts.description: Number of verification/repair loop iterations executed (up to 3).

verificationPromptTemplate.description: Which semantic-verification prompt template source was requested vs. actually resolved ({requestedSource, resolvedSource, templateKey, sha256}).

verifiedBranch.description: Branch checked out in the implementation worktree that was verified (same as 'branch').

workspaceRetained.description: True if the implementation worktree was left in place after the run.

worktreePath.description: Path to the isolated implementation worktree the run operated in.

testCycleState.description: Terminal state of the downstream child's test_cycle sub-workflow, if any ran; null/absent-shaped when the child never produced one.

testsPassed.description: Whether the downstream child's test cycle passed; null when no test cycle ran.

testReport.description: Human-readable summary from the downstream child's test cycle; null when no test cycle ran.
